definitions.explanation: A dog bred or trained to help in hunting, by tracking, chasing or retrieving game.

examples.japanese: {猟犬|りょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
{猟犬|りょうけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}いかけた→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧。
examples.english: The hunting dog chased the game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{猟犬|りょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧いった。
examples.english: Every winter morning my grandfather went into the mountains with his hunting dog.

notes:
From {猟|りょう} (hunting) + {犬|けん} (dog).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猟犬|りょうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{放|はな}す→放す：29986_hanasu⟧: to let the hounds loose
